title: Boolean repair satisfies the quadratic condition
statement: Let $n\ge 2$ and let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$. Convert $w$ coordinatewise to a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, apply the repair that leaves a vector with complete quadratic bit $1$ unchanged, otherwise flips a coordinate with derivative bit $1$ if one exists, and otherwise flips coordinates $0$ and $1$, and convert the result back to a Boolean vector $w'$. The complete quadratic bit of the encoded vector $w'$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $n$
